hero.title: I design websites, ads, print and apps.
hero.lead: I have spent more than ten years designing for agencies, small businesses and my own apps. I take on small jobs, monthly design work and full projects.

items.title: Small jobs
items.body: One landing page, an ad set, a brochure or a book cover, at a fixed price agreed before I start.

items.title: Monthly design
items.body: For small teams who need a designer most weeks, but not forty hours of one. You get a set number of hours each month for whatever comes up.

items.title: Projects
items.body: Websites, apps and brand identities. We start with a free call, and I send a clear estimate afterwards.

about.heading: Hi, I'm Ben.
paragraphs: I spent six years at Avidly, an APAC HubSpot partner, the last four leading design on websites, customer portals and web apps for clients across New Zealand and Australia.

Since 2025 I've worked for myself, designing for small businesses and building my own apps. I started out writing HTML and CSS, so I design with the build in mind, and developers tend to find my files easy to work with.

cta.heading: Got something in mind?
cta.body: Tell me what you're working on. The first call is free, and you'll get a straight answer on time and cost.

footer.blurb: Bentoji is the design practice of Ben Nguyen, a designer in Auckland working on websites, apps and brands.
